For a small solar generator with a solar panel included, I'd focus on kits with 250–300Wh batteries for maximum portability, or 600Wh if you need longer runtime.

My top choice is the Jackery Solar Generator 300 v2 with 40W solar panel for lightweight camping, charging phones and laptops, and emergency power.

Best small solar generator kits (2026)
Best compact pick

Jackery Solar Generator 300 v2

288Wh battery · 300W AC · 40W panel included

Around $300–$390

Easy to carry, with a LiFePO4 battery and enough power for phones, laptops, lights and small electronics. Its main drawback is slow solar recharging with the included 40W panel.

Jackery official store

BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 + 100W solar panel

288Wh battery · 600W AC · 100W panel included

Around $490

Better for running slightly higher-power devices, with a more capable included solar panel. A strong alternative if solar charging speed matters.

BLUETTI official store

EcoFlow RIVER 3 Plus + 110W solar panel

286Wh battery · 600W AC · 110W panel included

Great compact option for camping and small-device backup, with a larger panel than Jackery's smallest kit.
